skillSummaries.frontend: I build React and TypeScript interfaces meant to last: reusable component boundaries, deliberate state management, complex forms, and rendering kept under control performance-wise. I cover it all with unit tests using Jest and React Testing Library, testing behaviour rather than implementation, and I have also shipped Angular applications to production.
skillSummaries.backend: I design and expose REST APIs with Node.js and Next.js, on a PostgreSQL data model thought through up front rather than inherited by accident. I can pick up an existing back-end, Java EE included, and wire in third-party services — Supabase, Firestore, OAuth 2.0 authentication — without destabilising what already runs.
skillSummaries.cloud_devops: I deploy and operate my applications on Firebase and Google Cloud, with CI/CD pipelines that run the test suite before every release. I favour small, frequent releases that are easy to verify and to roll back over large, ceremonial deployments.
skillSummaries.data_ml: Coming from research at the Grenoble Computer Science Laboratory, I trained convolutional neural networks with PyTorch and integrated the resulting model into a Pepper robot. I kept from it the ability to read a paper, understand a model, and honestly assess what an AI component does — or does not — bring to a product.
skillSummaries.tools_methods: Git every day, demanding and well-argued code reviews, documentation written for whoever picks the project up after me. On an Agile team I estimate, split work into shippable increments, and raise blockers early rather than on demo day.
skillSummaries.soft_skills: Autonomous on unfamiliar ground: I frame the need, ask the right people the right questions, and move forward without needing to be chased. Curious and rigorous, I keep up with the ecosystem, gladly pass on what I learn, and work naturally with product, design, and back-end teams.

about.name: Léo Bello
about.title: Full-Stack Developer — React, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL
about.bio:
Front-end developer specialized in React and TypeScript, I work on ambitious web applications where code readability, interface robustness, and execution quality are essential. I focus on front-end architecture, API integration, performance, testing, and maintainability, with a product-oriented and long-term mindset.

I'm comfortable in environments where the front-end needs to stay reliable as the product grows in complexity: component architecture, state management, advanced forms, PostgreSQL/Supabase integration, code reviews, continuous improvement, and close collaboration with backend, design, and product teams. My goal is to build interfaces that are clear, stable, and durable, without unnecessary complexity.

projects.name: Prospeo
projects.summary: Thousands of tradespeople and small businesses have no website at all, and approaching them one by one costs more than it brings in. Prospeo automates the whole chain: it finds those businesses, builds them a site, puts it online, then sends them a proposal pointing at their own site — already live.
projects.approach: Detection through Google Maps, matching against the SIRENE company registry, and scoring that can be replayed on data already collected — criteria can be refined without crawling again. Copy written by an LLM under a strict schema, automatic Git commit and deployment, every step traced and timestamped. Human review before sending, email and SMS, with a database guarantee that a prospect can never be contacted twice.
projects.outcome: A long, asynchronous, failure-prone business chain held together end to end: background job orchestration, three third-party APIs, AI-generated content constrained by a schema and therefore verifiable, multi-tenant isolation through RLS and encrypted secrets. 52,000 lines, 115 test files.

projects.name: SignFlow
projects.summary: Looking for a role means re-reading the same listings across four sites that don't talk to each other, to keep three of them. SignFlow does that re-reading at night: four sources merged, republications of the same offer collapsed into a single entry, and one brief waiting in the morning.
projects.approach: Every offer is read by AI and checked against real criteria — remote work, pay, engagement length, technologies you no longer want to touch. Each ranking comes with its reason, and changing a criterion re-ranks the whole history instantly: the judgement is recomputed, not frozen at collection time.
projects.outcome: Turning a raw feed into a decision: normalising heterogeneous sources, reliable deduplication, AI judgement that is reproducible and auditable, and a data model that accepts rule changes after the fact. Nothing is sent without approval — the product prepares the decision, it does not take it.

experience.role: Full-Stack Developer React / Next.js — built from scratch, freelance

Fully developed with TDD — React / TypeScript front-end, Next.js back-end on Supabase and PostgreSQL — on a microservices, event-driven architecture designed to scale. Third-party integrations with SharePoint and Yousign, OAuth 2.0 / SSO authentication with full token lifecycle management.

A scope owned end to end rather than a single brick handed over: UX/UI mockups, tests written before the code, technical documentation, and deployment through CI/CD pipelines.

experience.role: Full-Stack Developer React / TypeScript — high-volume application, permanent contract
